race.comment: KAWA (6) went back early from her wide draw over 2100m at Ballarat Synthetic last time but hit the line strongly to finish fourth. Been going around in better-quality races than this of late and draws to advantage. FOREVER JEUNE (8) missed the placings two starts back then ran a better race and finished 3/4 of a length away in fourth last time out over 2000m at Warracknabeal. Another who has the talent to win but has a tricky gate. JUST SWIFT (7) was a strong maiden winner last time up to 2100m, so looks only further advantaged by the extra trip here. FIOROWNGOOD (1) got off the mark over 2000m at Casterton last start, scoring by 1.75 lengths. He's been consistent all prep and can be relied upon for an honest showing.
